definitions.precision: assigned points with auditable ground truth only; unmatched semantic/detection reported separately
definitions.recall: labeled target points within matched detection boxes; missed detections excluded from this conditional denominator
definitions.pair: independent projected-box IoU>=0.3 with 0.05 margin; unscored ambiguous pairs reported
definitions.range: only samples where actor nearest bounding-box surface truth was saved; failed original samples may lack it
definitions.timestamps: historical raw timestamps unavailable, replay uses same recorded frame IDs and equal placeholders
